assessments.reasoning: The instrument records main work in Section III (Question 3) and secondary work in Section VII (Question 7). Separately, in Section IX (Question 9, item 7), it records the exact time (hours and minutes) spent by each individual aged 12 and older on domestic tasks ('7 realizar los quehaceres de su hogar? (lavar, planchar, preparar y servir alimentos, barrer)'). This allows main work, secondary work, and domestic work to be distinguished for each person.
